# SetCameraClipPlaneEnabled

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Cameras](Blitz3D-Cameras)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetCameraClipPlaneEnabled:Void camera:Int32, index:Int32, enabled:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `camera` | In | Int32 | required | Camera handle. |
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | Which plane, from 0 to 5. |
| `enabled` | In | Int32 | required | True to cut with the plane, False to stop. |

## Description

Turns one of the 6 clip planes of a camera on or off. The plane itself is set with [SetCameraClipPlane](SetCameraClipPlane) and is kept while it is off. All planes of a new camera are off. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
cube = CreateCube()
PositionEntity cube, 0, 0, 5
SetCameraClipPlane camera, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0
While Not KeyHit(1)
	; Hold space to cut away the left half of the cube.
	SetCameraClipPlaneEnabled camera, 0, KeyDown(57)
	RenderWorld
	Flip
Wend
```
